messages:
morgan: Anyone up for a Ridge Run Relay this Sat 8am? 6.5mi loop split into 3 legs (2.5/2/2). Picnic + pizza after. Route: https://strava.app.link/ridge-route. RSVP on the quick form if you can make it.
ash: Love it. Level of technical trail? Any scrambling or exposure?
diego: Count me in. I can take a middle leg or help with transitions. I'll bring a small speaker. @emma you in? :sunglasses:
emma: I can do morning but only the middle 2mi leg. Is there a bathroom at the trailhead?
morgan: There's a port-a-potty by the trailhead and a small parking lot. Will push a calendar invite and a signup for leg prefs: https://forms.gle/shortlink (just pick preferred leg).
celeste: If anyone needs spare shoes I can bring a gently used pair (8.5). Also happy to pack hummus and snacks.
samir: Schedule works for me. I can pace the 2.5mi opener and help with transitions. Quick Q: any parking limits? Want to carpool from office @jeremy?
jeremy: I can drive 3 people, leaving the office at 7:15. Reply here if you want a spot.
morgan: Gear checklist (bring these pls):
```
- running shoes with tread
- water bottle + refillable bladder
- light wind layer
- hat/sunscreen
- small first-aid stuff
- cash for pizza
```
calendar-bot: morgan created event 'Ridge Run Relay' for Sat 8:00 AM — added 6 guests.
ash: If it's pouring should we postpone? Maybe post a final call by 6am on Sat.
morgan: Yep — if >50% chance of heavy rain we'll move to Sunday and I'll update by 6am. Excited! :muscle:
